notes: Smartphone accelerometer HAR dataset (UniMiB = University of Milano-Bicocca). Data collected with a Samsung Galaxy Nexus I9250 (Android 5.1.1) held in the trouser front pockets (left and right). Accelerometer sampled at ~50 Hz. 30 subjects (24 female, 6 male), ages 18-60. 11,771 samples/windows split into 17 fine-grained classes = 9 activities of daily living (ADL) + 8 types of falls; can be aggregated into coarser groupings (e.g. 2-class fall vs no-fall, 9 ADL). Windows are 3 s (151 samples) centered on the acceleration-magnitude peak. Signals provided as raw 3-axis acceleration (x,y,z). Verify exact sampling rate / window length against the paper when cross-checking code, since preprocessing (e.g. window size, class subset) varies by benchmark. arXiv preprint id 1611.07688; canonical published version DOI 10.3390/app7101101. Crossref confirms authors, venue (Applied Sciences 7(10):1101), 2017-10-24, CC BY 4.0.
